common.nothingToShow: Nothing to show in the {{view}} view.
page.title: k3s / RKE2
page.hint: What the nodes, the Addons and the HelmCharts tell of this k3s or RKE2 cluster. Read-only.
page.notRecognised: No node tells k3s or RKE2
page.otherDatastore: No embedded etcd member: SQLite or an external datastore (Sextant cannot tell which)
page.nodesTruncated: Only the first {{limit}} nodes are read.
hint.retrying: The install Job keeps failing and helm-controller keeps retrying it. The Job's logs tell why.
hint.applied: helm-controller created the install Job; its outcome is in the Job below.
hint.unknown: helm-controller has not reported a status (older versions write none); the Job below tells how the install went.
hint.bundled: Deployed from the server's manifests directory (Addon {{addon}}): changes made here are overwritten when the server restarts; use a HelmChartConfig instead.
job.title: Install Job
values.title: Values
values.note: Values may hold secrets: values under keys that look secret are hidden, and credentials are removed from addresses. The YAML section shows the stored object.
values.unreadable: The values are not shown: they cannot be read as YAML safely.
config.noChart: There is no HelmChart {{name}} in {{namespace}}: this HelmChartConfig overrides nothing now.
config.hint: A HelmChartConfig overrides the values of the HelmChart of the same name and namespace; helm-controller installs the chart again when it changes.
addon.hint: k3s applies this manifest from the server's manifests directory. A manifest it cannot apply is reported as a Warning event of this Addon.
node.argsNote: The values of tokens, keys, passwords and datastore addresses are never shown.
components.title: Bundled components
components.hint.k3s: What k3s deploys from its manifests directory. A component left out with --disable is not found.
components.hint.rke2: The charts RKE2 installs in kube-system. Which ones depend on the server's options (--cni, --ingress-controller, --disable).
components.unavailable: kube-system's Deployments or DaemonSets cannot be read.
components.truncated: Some lists are cut: the states may be incomplete.
components.state.notFoundServiceLb: Not in use: no LoadBalancer Service, or disabled with --disable {{flag}}
serviceLb.title: ServiceLB
serviceLb.hint: ServiceLB runs a DaemonSet per LoadBalancer Service and publishes the addresses of the nodes it runs on.
serviceLb.truncated: Only the first {{limit}} Services are listed.
values.contentHidden: valuesContent is set, but Sextant does not give it to extensions: it may hold secrets. The YAML section shows it.
values.setHidden: The set values are there, but Sextant does not give them to extensions: they may hold secrets. The YAML section shows them.
node.argsHidden: The node's arguments are there, but Sextant does not give them to extensions: they may hold the join token. The YAML section shows them.
